design_source.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
used_concepts: online exploration produces reusable historical traces
historical discovery experience becomes an empirical replay simulator
exploration policy improves offline while execution/evaluation interfaces remain fixed
improved exploration policy is redeployed online
design_source.intentional_deviation: DREAM-Jev remains conservative trajectory-retention replay: it never predicts that the fixed decision model would choose a different browser action or invent an unseen DOM outcome.

self_improvable: exploration policy data within the bounded ExplorationPolicy space
non_self_modifiable: model-routing security levels and transport enforcement
policy registry, suspension, and rollback implementation

gates: Q0 static integrity: manifest check + signature verification, compileall, ruff, JS syntax, lock, build, reproducible double-build
Q1 offline correctness: full pytest suite with committed coverage floor
Q2 browser execution: live Chrome guard suite + E2E (skipped, not passed, without a CDP endpoint)
Q3 adversarial: structured fuzz, crash injection, curated TCB mutation sweep, key-compromise drill, anchor-enforcement slice, live race loops
Q4 statistical: causal null/power/multiplicity Monte-Carlo grid + propensity draw

v0_9_2_upgrades: node-fair action-catalogue truncation (a giant select cannot starve later controls)
train/validation-only candidate selection with a single post-selection holdout evaluation
experiment arm rates bounded to [0.05, 0.95] — degenerate allocation rejected
Manski worst/best-case censoring bounds gating effect establishment
anytime-valid KL confidence sequence for sequential establishment
Bonferroni multiplicity control across concurrently tracked hypotheses
operator-declared input guarantee (JEV_INPUT_GUARANTEE, atomic|trusted) journaled per dispatch
TLS required for every non-loopback model endpoint

validation.authoritative_report: generated per-run via scripts/qualify.py --out report.json --report-md VALIDATION.generated.md
validation.live_browser_harness: passed: 47 guard checks against dedicated Chrome 154 via BU_CDP_URL (historical; CI live-guards job re-runs per push)
